ModMetaData.name: CPOLICE
ModMetaData.author: VincentZ
ModMetaData.description: CPOLICE rank pack add-on for Rocket's Ranks. Adds F1-F8 auxiliary police levels before J1-J13 police ranks. J9-J13 are set as officer ranks. Also adds visible CPOLICE uniforms, vests, caps, and rank-matched shoulder insignia apparel.
